text: There are four main types of stretching: static, ballistic, dynamic, and proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF). Static stretching has long been used in a warm-up, with the aim of enhancing performance. However, recent reviews of the literature surrounding the role of static stretching question this practice (51,52). There is little, if any, evidence that stretching pre- or post-participation prevents injury or subsequent muscle soreness (32,34,46,48,51,52).
